entities.summary: Christopher Corchiani Sr. is an American-Italian former professional basketball player who played at the point guard position. He played briefly in the National Basketball Association after a college career at NC State. Corchiani was the first college player to amass 1,000 career assists and as of 2026 is one of only five players in history to achieve the milestone.
